entries.mem0ai/mem0: Mem0 is a universal memory layer for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider, available as managed cloud or self-hosted open-source software under Apache-2.0. It supports semantic, keyword, and entity-based retrieval, with SDKs, a CLI, a self-hosted server, and a cloud platform.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term agent memory through retain, recall, and reflect operations. It offers Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients, and supports multiple LLM providers, including local options.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents and an official Hermes Agent memory provider. It organizes context as browsable files and directories, supports scoped search, and loads context through L0, L1, and L2 tiers.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee builds persistent agent memory from documents, code, and conversations using a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It supports local text processing without an LLM and includes a CLI for remembering and recalling text.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory is a memory engine and API, as well as an official Hermes Agent memory provider. It extracts facts and handles updates, contradictions, and forgetting, with connectors for services including Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain is an opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agent that stores facts with provenance and supports corrections and withdrawal. Agents can share memory while transient task state stays local; optional features include semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peers, sessions, and messages over time. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted deployments and provides Python and TypeScript SDKs; the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper builds on it.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: ByteRover CLI treats memory as a Git repository, managing a context tree with Git-like version control. It offers an interactive TUI and REPL, and supports 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a SQLite-backed memory layer for Hermes agents with one pure-Python dependency. It integrates through MCP, native providers, or a Python SDK; BEAM results are reported for v3.0.0, while LongMemEval is pending.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto consolidates memories, reconciles conflicting information, and briefs agents with relevant memories before they act. It also supports importing and exporting memory through the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory OS is a seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that includes vector search, structured facts, fabric recall, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses local infrastructure with Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite, and applies a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive, self-improving context harness for helping agents succeed on complex tasks. It evaluates task runs, keeps useful lessons while discarding dead ends, and produces traces, reports, and playbooks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Hermes Agent plugin uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG to persist messages, with the goal of preserving context without losing messages. Its lcm_grep and lcm_recall tools help recover details from stored conversations.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: deja-vu searches session histories from supported coding agents, so users can find and resume past sessions from months earlier. It provides a terminal interface and runs locally without a model or server.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a self-hosted Honcho backend. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers, and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first layer for agent identity, memory, and secrets, with portable state across several agent harnesses and MCP clients. It can import files, webpages, and agent conversations, and includes a dashboard for browsing memories and their sources.
entries.plur-ai/plur: plur stores shared agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, using an open format for multi-agent systems. It offers local search after a one-time model download, with keyword fallback; its README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500).
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device memory and context engine that combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking. It can generate session handoffs and capture decisions and preferences, with integrations through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a durable, file-based memory system that stores data locally in a SQLite file and provides FTS5 search with a five-tier schema. Its package family includes an SDK, CLI, Hermes adapter, MCP server, and LangGraph BaseStore, without a vector database or embeddings.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context ordering to support prefix-cache sharing, including for text and multimodal contexts. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other listed runtimes, and provides a context index for reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This Hermes memory plugin uses an embedded backend by default, with an HTTP backend also available. Its retrieval results include a why_retrieved explanation, and it supports contradiction tracking and memory canonicalization.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: llm-wiki-cli is an agent-driven CLI for proactively recalling, maintaining, and evolving persistent knowledge across sessions. It builds a source-grounded Wiki with citations and history, without requiring embeddings or a vector database.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: agentcairn provides long-term, cross-project memory for coding agents, using an Obsidian vault as the source of truth. It stores durable memories as inspectable Markdown files and uses a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and retrieval.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: flowstate-qmd uses an anticipatory cache that watches agent session logs to prefetch context. It pairs local storage with SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp, and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack combines Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace under a single memory owner, using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management. It provides the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep pairs semantic search with BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal, and automatically indexes codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. Its edge tags link stored notes in navigable, bidirectional relationships.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: Hermes Tool Slimmer reduces tool-schema tokens through local keyword-based ranking and supports Tool Search. It integrates as middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19 or later, and includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing configurations.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS adds a Git-backed context and workflow layer for Claude Code, Codex, and other supported agents. Its workflows cover migration, handoffs, and memory proposals, while integrations remain opt-in rather than being enabled automatically.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin stores memory in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships. Its importance-weighted recall surfaces higher-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: Hermes Local Knowledge indexes configured local sources and selected Hermes runtime sources for capability search and routing. It registers five tools for search, retrieval, traversal, feedback, and usage reports, along with three lifecycle hooks.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Hermes AgentMemory is a pull-model episodic memory plugin with an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log of prefetch operations. It supports immediate event deletion, without persistent summaries that could affect later recall.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/hermes-blind: Hermes Blind extracts the original goal from the first user turn of a long Claude Code or Codex session, with goals, first-sentence, and full extraction modes. It skips tool output and other non-user-turn records, and does not use a summarizing model or external service.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK for x402 payments and an MCP server for budget-bound agent wallets. It operates without a backend, database, or API keys.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes Agent, injecting bounded, ranked context before turns. Its tools support searching, retrieving, saving, and updating memories, with temporal filters for search and context recall.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: The Exabase plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools to search and manually store memories, with configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault Code Tools provides private local code memory for repositories, with slash commands for search, file reads, context, and Q&A. It supports Hermes CLI, Telegram, and Hermes Desktop, and includes repository sync and indexed Git-history search commands.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB-Hermes provides long-term memory for Hermes Agent with AES-256-GCM encryption at rest by default. It offers native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon modes, with HNSW approximate-nearest-neighbor, sparse, and FM-index retrieval.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield provides 17 tools for memory management and knowledge-graph traversal. Its hybrid search combines BM25, vector, and graph methods, and it can automatically checkpoint context during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: Agent Memory Kit is a file-based memory-curation loop that works with Markdown and outputs reviewable JSON diffs, without a database. Its “rot” and “lint” curators flag stale or conflicting facts, while a local Git repository tracks and can revert changes.

entries.obra/superpowers: Superpowers combines composable skills that instruct agents with a software-development workflow spanning specification, design sign-off, planning, and subagent execution. It belongs in this list for teams seeking both reusable agent instructions and a defined development process; installation is separate for each harness.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: Open Design is a local-first design and prototyping system with skills, design templates, design systems, and plugins. Its support for multiple coding agents—including Hermes Agent—through skills, CLI, MCP, or runtime adapters makes it a design-focused option in this list.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This project provides structured cybersecurity skills across 34 security domains, with mappings to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3. Its broad platform compatibility makes it a security-focused skills library for agents.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Drawio-skill turns natural-language prompts and real sources into editable .drawio diagrams. Its incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations, while the diagramctl CLI and optional MCP server provide ways to use it.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Internet Court provides a master router and connector skills for agent-to-agent commerce, alongside vendored copies of official protocol skills. It adds a verification and dispute-resolution layer, distinguishing it from skills focused on a single content or development task.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Avoid AI Writing can score files or piped text for detectable AI-writing patterns and offers a rewrite mode with up to two editing passes. Its in-place editing explicitly refuses source code, configuration, and generated data.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw uses background evolution to deduplicate and improve skills, and unifies skill libraries across agents, devices, and team members. Its integrations include Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform skills library includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills, with compatibility for Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications. It also maintains session state in the project's docs folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This project offers 822 professional agent skills, including skills for writing PRDs and postmortems, that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. Its installer copies selected skill files into a tool's config folder, and the project is MIT-licensed.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: YouTube-skills provides skills for transcripts, video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction. It supports Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, Claude Code, and Cursor, and requires a TranscriptAPI key with a 100-credit free tier.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: Hermes Skill Factory watches active workflows to detect and propose reusable skills, then generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds. Slash commands let users manage, list, and save detected patterns.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Super-Hermes teaches Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks, with pre-built analytical lenses for various domains. It reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Adds type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI, including remote skill registries sourced from Git and S3. It also provides tools for bundled resources and script execution, with sandboxing to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: Turns rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. Lite and Full modes accommodate different project complexity, while a spec review gate evaluates work with PASS/FAIL models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Combines prose, diagrams, and source code in .lit.md files, then extracts runnable source files with a tangler. It also syncs edits to those source files back into the literate document, making it useful for keeping code and documentation connected across agents.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Provides a harness for long-running AI agents, storing coordination data in each repository’s shared Git root. Its supervised teams use defined roles and work states, alongside plugins, recipes, and skills.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Shares memory across instances through Markdown files and automatically captures high-value decisions and outcomes. It also provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: Offers Portuguese-language Hermes Agent skills in SKILL.md format, along with guides on installation, production, cron, MCP, and skill authoring. Contributions are submitted through pull requests, making this a community resource for Portuguese-speaking Hermes users.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Provides prompting skills for FLUX image and video generation, with BFL API integration for polling and webhooks. Its FLUX 3 video suite includes eight specialist skills.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Lists nine Chainlink skills, each following the Agent Skills spec, for oracle network and smart contract interactions. The README describes the repository as community examples only, and gives installation instructions using npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Creates agentskills.io-compliant skills from repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It supports both automated and step-by-step workflows, with testing and export included.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a workflow language for AI that checks workflows before calling a model and runs with a model of your choice. It also verifies a tamper-evident record for each run.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Provides a registry of reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, with a Python SkilldockClient and CLI. It supports installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Supports autonomous execution of long-running, multi-step tasks with checkpoints and real-time tracking of progress and decisions. Built-in rollback procedures provide a recovery path when execution needs to be undone.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. Secure HTTPS access and a guided credential-validation setup make it a practical skill for working with Nextcloud from Hermes Agent.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Browse, search, and install community skills through a hub that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification. It also federates searches across GitHub and Hugging Face and operates autonomously via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Find relevant skills through five retrieval layers, from hard triggers to semantic embeddings, with results combined using RRF fusion. By narrowing skill lists before LLM calls, it aims to reduce token usage and can gracefully degrade when embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: An ADHD-friendly personal execution OS for habits and study blocks, with agent-driven scheduling and system design through an MCP connection. It stores data in a single local SQLite file and includes a React web app and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only code-review skill that uses three parallel subagents to examine edge cases, adversarial concerns, and integration risks, then consolidates and triages findings. It combines deterministic scans using named security and linting tools with proof-of-concept verification in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Simplify code with three parallel agents focused on Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness, supporting TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. A tiered application process and approval gate help control how changes are applied.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A cybersecurity lab for Hermes Agent that brings together skills and tools for network work, forensics, and exploitation. Its highlights include 2,077 skills across multiple repositories, 131+ tools, and integrations with 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Adapt verified procedures for task decomposition, investigation, and preventing premature stopping. It requires evidence-based verification gates, provides a protocol for reproduction and causal debugging, and includes a Python goal engine for persistent task state.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration and progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files. It uses Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading and can automatically register common agent skill directories.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: A local, real-time dashboard for tracking Hermes Agent sessions, token costs, skill analytics, and other activity. It is read-only, desensitizes local logs, and offers optional incident alerts through Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: A collection of plain-markdown skills for session management, multi-session reconciliation, worktree recovery, code review, and skill scaffolding. The skills can be installed by copying a directory or using the bundled installer.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This Claude Code skill creates reproducible demo recordings for repository READMEs, using VHS tape files or Playwright scripts. It also optimizes GIFs toward a target size under 8 MB and supports terminal CLIs, TUIs, web apps, and libraries.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This skill generates Claude Code extensions and portable Agent Skills core files, then validates them against runtime-specific profiles with CI-friendly exit codes. It also checks official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect field drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server searches remoteopenclaw.com for MCP servers, agent skills, and plugins, and provides direct installation commands for discovered tools. It supports MCP-compatible clients including Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project creates a feedback loop for agent skills by fetching sessions, indexing installed skills, and drafting structured improvement proposals. Proposals are review-only by default, with an evaluation gate that supports deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These Hermes Agent skills route file operations using path syntax for native Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL. They also select and verify existing Python interpreters compatible with a project.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides agent skills for social platforms, web search, scraping, and enrichment, alongside packaged workflows for prospecting, SEO, and newsletters. Its API skills require a key or OAuth through the MCP route.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of Hermes skills transcribes Douyin videos into structured Markdown and SRT subtitles, and uses rules to remove common Chinese AI-writing patterns. It also extracts structured data from PDFs and images using macOS Vision.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This Hermes Agent plugin lets agents find open support bounties, purchase ticket context, and submit answers for review; a human approves the winning answer. It also supports creating a bounty board and provides public wallet earnings records.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal tests agent skills for structure, functionality, and security in isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for certificate verification and skill submission.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: Scavio for Hermes Agent provides structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server, with 191 tools exposed. It also includes five workflow skills and supports Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.parkyucheol-del/alphapipeline: Alphapipeline provides token honeypot, tax, and liquidity checks alongside market data such as DEX slippage and funding rates. It offers these capabilities through REST endpoints and a remote MCP server.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This Hermes Agent skill generates structured Chinese news briefings across geographic scales, from global to street level. It incorporates user interests through semantic memory to expand searches, and reports core conclusions with suggested actions.
entries.aidatatools-dev/astro-agents-mcp: This project provides an MCP endpoint for Western and Vedic astrology, with no authentication required. It returns deterministic results that can be verified with SHA-256 hashes, and supports per-call REST payments via x402 or MPP.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: Agentic-MCP-Skill is a progressive MCP client that loads server metadata and tool schemas incrementally through three layers, helping minimize token usage. Its socket-based daemon architecture keeps connections persistent, making it a distinct choice for agents that need to discover MCP tools progressively.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project packages AI coding agents and development tools with Nix, including Hermes, and provides a `nix run` command for listed tools. Its packages are updated automatically each day, making it a Nix-based option for running Hermes.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone collects scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android through Termux. Its highlights include an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android, OpenClaw configuration guides, and hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This Termux-based installer and guide runs Hermes Agent on Android using proot-distro Ubuntu. It supports interactive model setup, gateway services, shell command execution, and external providers or local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart offers direct or operator-ready CRD-based workflows for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It includes single-writer state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings the Hermes AI assistant to Android through Termux and to iOS through iSH. It also integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging, and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: hermesclaw runs Hermes Agent with hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It restricts network and filesystem access at the kernel level and offers configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides searchable logs, metrics, alert rules, and access through a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image for Hermes Agent that includes mini-swe-agent and the official Hermes installation. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and lets users build specific Hermes tags with build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This project provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment, with declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents. It supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills, and integrates secrets through systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for running multiple Hermes Agent instances from one web application, with separate workspaces and identities. It provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp channels and granular policies for tools, paths, and network access.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable package that runs from a USB drive or other drive without host installation or registry writes. It includes Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes with isolated data environments, and bundles tools for offline use, including Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals rescue tools.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It also enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.jyje/hermes-agent-helm: This Helm chart deploys Hermes Agent on Kubernetes, with installation available from an OCI registry or a GitHub Pages Helm repository. Optional Copilot and Codex device-login bootstrap and CI testing on an ephemeral kind cluster make it a Kubernetes-focused deployment option.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents is a multi-agent framework for financial trading research, with analysts covering fundamentals, sentiment, news, and technical signals. It is intended for research, not trading advice.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides self-hosted orchestration for assigning tasks, registering agents, browsing memory, and tracking costs. It offers Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces, with local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: Agent of Empires is a TUI and web control surface for managing multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and several other agents. It supports persistent tmux sessions, Git worktrees, and multi-repository workspaces; its web dashboard includes terminal access and diffs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Hermes Agent Control Room is a template for scaling Hermes Agent from a single VPS agent to specialist teams and automated workflows. Its level-based architecture includes a task bus for delegation and handoffs, plus skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw helps build autonomous agent swarms, with support for 23+ LLM providers, durable agent memory, and MCP tool integration. Visual org charts show how work is delegated across agent teams.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: Minions is a Mission Control interface for creating, supervising, and reviewing autonomous Hermes Agent work. It tracks tasks and review queues on a Kanban board, streams agent reasoning and tool execution, and requires human verification of agent-proposed completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator routes and coordinates work through a strict pipeline architecture.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: Hermes Agent Team is a local web system for collaboration among agents built on Hermes Agent profiles, MCP, ACP, and Hermes Kanban. Leader and Specialist agents manage task lifecycles, while a real-time Web UI shows agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: Hermes Agent Metaharness automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It coordinates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations and provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator stages a competition between two AI companies, orchestrating nine autonomous agents for task execution and learning with Paperclip and Hermes Agent. Its real-time dashboard visualizes agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: HermesAgent-MultiModel runs a local Mixture-of-Agents stack that queries models in parallel and synthesizes their responses, using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It is designed for consumer GPUs, optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware, and described as having no cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Codegraph builds a full project graph with `codegraph init`, using structural extraction and cross-file resolution across supported languages. Its MCP support makes that pre-indexed code knowledge available to Hermes Agent and other coding agents.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale tracks token usage across AI coding agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, and Gemini. It pairs a terminal interface with a visualization dashboard and lets users submit usage data to a leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: Claude Tap provides a local trace viewer for coding-agent API traffic, including prompts, tool calls, streaming responses, and token usage. It can compare adjacent requests to show context changes and redacts common auth headers before recording traces.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: Token Monitor displays real-time token usage, costs, and rate limits across 46+ AI coding tools, reading Hermes Agent state alongside other CLIs. It also shows historical trends and usage breakdowns, with sync across multiple devices.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI provides design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers, and is compatible with AI providers that support markdown or general prompting. Its integrations include Hermes Agent, Cursor, Claude, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: Oh My Hermes adds an opinionated workflow layer for building, shipping, and operating apps with Hermes Agent. It includes skills for product briefs, design handoffs, and implementation, plus seven agents covering roles across the product lifecycle.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes Skins customizes the Hermes terminal UI with community themes, including changes to banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners. YAML-based configuration supports theme creation, with examples ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk aesthetics.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a command-line static linter for AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts, with HERM v1.1 scoring. It scans prompts, tool definitions, schemas, and agent files, then reports findings with specific fixes and supported line references.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place describes itself as a social economy for autonomous AI agents. It provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol, human-readable @handle identity registration, and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel Browser is an AI-native browser for autonomous agent control via MCP, with support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers. Its supervisor sidebar manages agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads, and it supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: Hermes-CCC ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to Claude Code Channel, running natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth. It also includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: Cognee Integrations is a monorepo of Cognee-owned integration packages with two tiers: a permanent knowledge graph and a session cache. Its Claude Code plugin auto-captures and auto-recalls context.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup combines RTK and Caveman templating for CLI workflows, with claimed token savings of 90–99%. It includes 40+ preconfigured skills for finance, DevOps, and research, plus automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a framework for creating scoped Hermes agents, with per-folder configuration and skills. It supports switching between default and scoped agents and keeping memories, tools, and custom instructions local to a project.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This project automates installation of Hermes Agent and 12+ supporting services, with three deployment tiers from a minimum viable setup to a production stack. It also supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers OpenClaw files such as SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives to Hermes. It also maps configurations and credentials to Hermes formats and can set up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco is a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations and monitors multi-agent systems. Its two monitoring modes include passive analysis and scheduled active probing, while config-aware baselines track performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes Voice adds voice interaction with wake-word support and runs offline without API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro, along with adaptive turn-taking and barge-in.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Hermes Startup is a local runtime for pursuing online opportunities, operating in deterministic zero-network mode by default. It requires explicit approval for consequential actions and external writes, and includes contracts for opportunities, offer previews, and exact approvals.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This Hermes memory plugin provides semantic search and multi-dimensional memory storage. It includes tools to search, add, and delete memories, as well as a circuit breaker for MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: CC Switch is a cross-platform manager for Hermes Agent and several other agent CLIs, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It lets users switch API providers in one click and manage MCP, Skills, and Prompts in one place.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source cowork app for Hermes Agent and other agent CLIs, with a built-in agent that does not require a separate CLI installation. It includes 21 professional assistants and supports macOS, Windows, and Linux.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI provides a three-panel interface for chatting with Hermes Agent, managing sessions, and browsing workspace files. Profiles, settings, session tools, and themes round out the interface, which can also be accessed remotely through an SSH tunnel.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: Hermes Desktop is a companion app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent, using the official Hermes install script. Its GUI manages profiles, sessions, skills, and tools, and the app is available from the project website or GitHub Releases.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko Studio is a Hermes Agent dashboard for chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and channel configuration. It supports shared and group chats, visual workflows, and persistent sessions, and is available as a desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, as well as through npm and Docker.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: Hermes Workspace brings chat, a terminal, a memory browser, a skills manager, and an inspector into a native web workspace. It also offers Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers, plus a file browser with Monaco and a PTY terminal.
entries.spacering-net/codeg: CodeG is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode, as a desktop or self-hosted app. Users can import, search, resume, and hand off sessions, or delegate across agents and queue to-dos in worktrees.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This Hermes workspace connects directly to local or SSH hosts and provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs. Its embedded terminal enables direct shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Hermes-CN-Desktop is a Windows-first Chinese desktop app for Hermes Agent, with support for Windows and macOS and native window and process management. Its interface includes chat, memory management, and LaTeX/Markdown rendering, while the built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel provides health checks and updates.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime through a local gateway, Hermes Cloud, or a remote gateway. It supports agent chats, attachments, and page-context capture; Hermes Control is opt-in and Chromium-only.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iOS app for driving a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone, paired with a hermes-webui server. It is a client-only app for iOS 18 and later; users run the server, and the app is free with no analytics or tracking.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop AI agent workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw, plus custom LLM model routing. Its runtime dashboard tracks token usage and latency, while a live workspace shows code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: Hermes HUD is an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for monitoring agent activity. It tracks agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs, and adds a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: Agent Sessions is a native macOS browser and cockpit for Hermes agents and other coding-agent CLIs, with analytics and limits tracking. Search across prompts, responses, tool activity, errors, and file paths, then resume supported sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp; session history stays on the Mac, with no telemetry.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted browser dashboard for the Hermes AI agent stack, bringing together a terminal, file explorer, session overview, cron management, system metrics, and agent status. Its highlighted features include streaming chat with tool-call visualization, MCP server lifecycle controls, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: Hermes Desktop OS1 is a native macOS workspace for running Hermes Agent on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It offers one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Hermes Agent Mission Control is a self-hostable dashboard template that connects to a local Hermes agent through a Postgres message bus. Its approval inbox lets users review requests with side effects, making it a fit for workflows that need a web dashboard and an approval step.
entries.liftaris/herm: Herm is an alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing agent sessions. It also includes a kanban board for agentic work and task management, alongside controls for profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a locally run, mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0. Its ten-page interface includes terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, background spawning for up to five concurrent agent instances, and Telegram validation using dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: Portable Hermes Agent packages Hermes as a Windows desktop application, described as requiring no installation, Docker, or administrator rights. Its highlights include 100 tools across 20+ toolsets, cloud AI and LM Studio local models, and a workflow engine with scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: Hermes UI is a glassmorphic web interface for a self-hosted Hermes Agent, combining chat with real-time log streaming. It also provides a file browser, task tracking dashboard, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Hermes WebUI is a process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes, with real-time views of session activity and cost tracking. It supports inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, while configuration and environment variables are available in read-only form.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: Pan UI is a self-hosted AI workspace centered on chat, with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It combines a marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers with isolated profiles for separate sessions, memory, and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: Hermes Agent Desktop is a native desktop client for multi-agent work, with streaming chat, model switching, and a PM orchestrator. It highlights collaboration among 20 specialized AI agents and a visual skill store with 50+ curated one-click installations.
entries.robbyczgw-cla/hermes-ui-plus: An unofficial, open-source interactive chat client for self-hosted Hermes Agent, with answer cards for checklists, choices, forms, and rankings. It also lets you approve or deny commands from your phone and runs on Android, web, and macOS, with a Linux alpha.
